question: Which of the following combinations is an example of the balanced meal?
solution:
The correct answer is **"__Roti, pulses, vegetables__"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• A **healthy diet** is one that enhances or maintains general health.
 
• The body receives the key nutrients it needs from a balanced diet, including proper amounts of hydration, **macronutrients** like protein, micronutrients like vitamins, and fibre.
